items.description: The Rovuma River forms the natural border between Mozambique and Tanzania, supporting diverse ecosystems along its banks.
Inda Island is a small island off the coast of Mozambique, known for its pristine beaches and vibrant coral reefs.
Lake Chiuta is a shallow freshwater lake on the border with Malawi, important for fishing and birdwatching.
Pungo Mountain in Zambézia Province is an important site for local flora and fauna, offering rich biodiversity.
Gaza Lake is a freshwater lake in Gaza Province, serving as a vital water source for surrounding communities.
Bangue Island is part of the Bazaruto Archipelago, known for its pristine beaches and as a nesting site for sea turtles.
Nampula forests are crucial ecosystems, harboring diverse flora and fauna in the region.
Songo Mountain is a prominent elevation in Tete Province, known for its rich biodiversity.
Lupata Gorge is a spectacular breakthrough of the Zambezi River through the mountains, famous for its scenic beauty.
Macossa Forest is an important forest in Manica Province, home to diverse flora and fauna.
Massingir Lake is a large reservoir fed by the Olifants River, important for irrigation and fishing.
Moamba Mountain in Maputo Province is known for its lush vegetation and diverse birdlife.
Savane Lake is a freshwater lake in Sofala Province, serving as a vital water source for local communities.
The Chinde River is a distributary of the Zambezi River on the Indian Ocean, important for navigation and fishing.
Lupata Forest is a protected forest in Sofala Province, characterized by its rich biodiversity.
